_source.describes: The Dungeons generator: FLAIL!'s five d6 theme axes, and the concepts an area is keyed with.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: The five theme columns are FLAIL!'s own d6 tables, reproduced in face order, which the Third-Party Licence permits: it covers rules text, random tables, table entries and terminology. 'stocking' is the keying checklist, which FLAIL! presents as nine concepts to choose from rather than a die roll — so the generator picks across all nine rather than rolling a d6 and stranding the last three. That checklist is credited in FLAIL! itself to the Goblin Punch blog, so the credit is passed on here rather than stopping at Games Omnivorous.
